title: If I had… I would…
regra: No 2º condicional (uma situação imaginária), depois do if vem o passado: had, were, didn't… E na outra parte vem would. Mesmo falando de agora: If I had time, I would travel.

exemplos.en: If I had time, I would travel.
exemplos.pt: Se eu tivesse tempo, eu viajaria.

exemplos.en: If I were rich, I wouldn't work.
exemplos.pt: Se eu fosse rico, eu não trabalharia.

fofoca.gaps: My friend Ana always says: if I [[had]] money, I [[would]] travel. If I [[had]] time, I would learn Japanese. If I [[were]] rich, I wouldn't work! But she spends all her money on shoes. If she [[didn't]] buy so many shoes, she would have money to travel!

options: If I had time, I would travel.
If I have time, I would travel.
If I had time, I will travel.
If I were rich, I wouldn't work.
If I am rich, I wouldn't work.
If I were rich, I won't work.
If she didn't buy shoes, she would have money.
If she doesn't buy shoes, she would have money.
If she didn't buy shoes, she will have money.
